course_description: This course will provide an introduction to current techniques used in game design.Topics will include game engines, game mechanics, autonomous game agents, and multi-player games. Prerequisites: COMP 285. (F;S;SS)

topics.title: Develop game design vocabulary for talking about games and their play
Put into practice the basic tools of game design.
Understand the demands gameplay makes on players
Experience the iterative game design process.
Develop critical thinking skills related to the analysis of games and play
